title: Claude System definition — systems/<name>/system.json
description: Validates a single System's manifest. The 'name' field must equal the containing folder name under systems/ (enforced by CI validate.yml, not by JSON Schema alone). See SYSTEM_SPEC.md and docs/creating-a-system.md.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor tooling. Not required for validation; allowed so files that include '$schema' pass strict additionalProperties.

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for the System. Must exactly match the containing folder name under systems/. Must be unique across the registry.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name shown in list/info/search results.

description.description: Short summary of what the System does. Shown in search/list and registry index.
examples: A focused environment for contributing to open-source projects with guided review and PR workflows.

keywords.description: Searchable keywords. Used by the registry index to power search/list.

category.description: Optional grouping for browsing the registry. If omitted, treated as 'other' for display.

author.description: Author or maintainer of this System.

name.description: Display name of the author or organization.

github.description: GitHub username or org handle (without @). Optional.

url.description: Author homepage or profile URL. Optional.

license.description: SPDX license expression (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC, GPL-3.0-only). Must be a valid SPDX identifier.

repository.description: Optional but recommended: URI to the author's own repo for this System, if they maintain one outside this monorepo. If omitted, the System lives only in this monorepo under systems/<name>/.

bugs.description: Where issue reports for this System should go. If omitted, tooling should treat the default as '<this monorepo>/issues' tagged with the System name — do NOT assume repository exists.

url.description: URL of the bug tracker or issues page.

homepage.description: Optional homepage or documentation URL for this System.

specVersion.description: Version of the System spec this manifest targets. Used to detect breaking spec changes.

dependencies.description: Optional list of other Systems this System depends on. Defaults to [] if omitted.

items.description: A single dependency on another System by name and semver range.

name.description: kebab-case name of the depended-on System.

version.description: Semver version or range (e.g. ^1.0.0, ~0.2.3, 1.2.3). Exact syntax is not validated beyond being a non-empty string.

permissions.description: Capabilities this System may request at install/run time. Must be declared honestly; reviewed during PR but not independently verified at runtime. See docs/security.md.
